TicTacToeModel - Class in app.games.tictactoe
> tictactoe rules & game state > board > whose turn it is (X/O) > if move is legal > how moves change the board > when win/loss/draw happens > who won (X/O) > must work separate from > how board is displayed > where input came from (terminal/gui/server) > what type of player made the move (ai/human) EX: > doMove() --> send move to Controller so it can tell View to update with the move made > bool: isValidMove() > SwitchTurn() --> change per move whose turn it is > bool: isGameOVer() > GameResult: getResult()
